A major usability and reliability release: the workspace becomes a real home inside Obsidian, streaming output is rebuilt for smoothness, and the persistence layer gets a ground-up fix.

## 🏠 New home & workspace integration
Settings render inside the view (Get Started–style full screen); chat pop-out window (780×720) keeps the session intact on close; history menu always visible and refreshes live.

## ⌨️ Streaming & reading experience
Typewriter rebuilt in three layers with rAF frame locking; streaming no longer force-follows scroll; normalized citations + new Base Citation toggle; traffic-light status dots.

## 💾 Persistence reliability
Root-cause fix for data loss on reload/kill: millisecond per-note persistence + durable snapshots every ≥10 min. Notes are never silently re-embedded (mtime zeroing + vector adjudication + unified entry). Unified index counts; Rebuild always clickable; stale vault.db / bak-* auto-cleaned.

## 🔍 Search & indexing
Semantic search path pre-filter (folder or single note, via MCP and the chat agent); silent mtime reconciliation; true renames without re-embedding; CORS fallback; excluded dirs ignored by auto-indexing.

## 📤 Sharing & onboarding
LAN note sharing from the editor title bar (QR code, chunked rendering, TOC on wide screens); Get Started as a universal hub; onboarding refreshed across 11 languages.

## ⚙️ Model & settings pages
Cherry-style provider/model pages: horizontal tabs, API key modal, no more list jumping; dark theme throughout; Pro license card; endpoint switching row.

## 🧰 Platform & tools
Obsidian 1.15 adaptation; new web_search / mcp_info agent tools; extended debug toolkit; MCP absolute-path normalization; brand unified to Semlink.

**Download**: Obsidian community plugin store, or <https://github.com/ouou365/Semlink/releases/tag/2.2.0>
